title: Fenton Literature Screener
description: The first step of multi-agent Fenton data mining: reads one paper (markdown or the PDF text layer, up to 100,000 characters per call), decides whether the system is heterogeneous Fenton, records data availability, runs a three-route duplicate check (graph identifiers, graph semantic search, group shared library), and returns pass/skip/manual with quoted evidence. All rules are inlined in system.md with no skills attached; the private tool read_pdf reads the PDF text layer; the model is a local Qwen. Read-only; the main agent writes datamining/00_screening.json.
